source: Fresh recording of the authenticated local Dreamaan app
reference: Owner-supplied November 21 preview: workspace overview, Studio image gallery, and credit analytics

runtime.scope: Current integrated local preview, including preserved unmerged Studio changes; not a clean dev-branch-only deployment.

processing: Native 1920x1080 browser recording. Loading periods trimmed and three real scenes joined as H.264 MP4, CRF 18, with fast-start metadata. Poster is a full-resolution workspace screenshot; the old 320x180 clip is not upscaled.
filters: Images selected and Hide failed enabled through Studio View settings before recording.
network: Recorded through the local 7070 proxy. Forwarded media requests were served from that same local proxy to avoid the separate CDE sign-in gateway; real application responses and asset bytes were retained.
privacy: Sign-in, credentials, session state, and recording scripts are excluded from published media and repository contents.
generation: Existing content only. No generation submitted or credits spent.
earlierTour: Retained November 7 captures are labeled as earlier versions in the product tour.
